verdict.rationale: Lighthouse is an immigration legal-services firm whose case-preparation platform supports document upload and progress tracking. Running such a product headlessly or in a CI pipeline is a category error, not a question buyers of immigration services would reasonably ask. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships a headless, CLI, or CI mode that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
